say:1:1536101001:1.text: I'm getting the rites ready to welcome our warriors home!
say:1:1536101001:1.source_cn: 我在准备仪式，迎接猎血节归来的勇士！
say:1:1536101001:1.male: I'm getting the rites ready to welcome our warriors home!
say:1:1536101001:1.female: I'm getting the rites ready to welcome our warriors home!

say:2:1536101002:1.text: They'll be granted the Herdmaster's blade and crowned the mightiest of the Wildborn.
say:2:1536101002:1.source_cn: 他们会获得兽群之主的赐剑，成为雅库伯尔最强的战士！
say:2:1536101002:1.male: They'll be granted the Herdmaster's blade and crowned the mightiest of the Wildborn.
say:2:1536101002:1.female: They'll be granted the Herdmaster's blade and crowned the mightiest of the Wildborn.

say:3:1536101003:1.text: With them, nothing will stand in the Wildborn's way!
say:3:1536101003:1.source_cn: 有了他们，雅库伯尔将所向披靡！
say:3:1536101003:1.male: With them, nothing will stand in the Wildborn's way!
say:3:1536101003:1.female: With them, nothing will stand in the Wildborn's way!
